content.introduction: The sources indicate that several companies have reported their earnings recently. Chevron and Exxon hit all-time highs due to soaring refining profits amid geopolitical tensions. Coinbase saw a 66% surge in net income in the third quarter, benefiting from bitcoin investment gains. Amazon AWS experienced 39% revenue growth, while Intel's stock plunged 21% due to a PC slowdown. Reddit posted third-quarter earnings and plans a new login requirement test. Rivian's earnings beat estimates with rising software revenue and R2 deliveries. Starbucks' sales missed expectations, but its U.S. turnaround is gaining steam. The sources don't provide a definitive answer for today's date earnings.
